views.title: Theme Toggle Button
views.description: Small button in the navigation header that switches between light and dark themes. Accessible via keyboard and screen reader.

views.title: All Themed Views (Implicit)
views.description: Every page/view in the application responds to the active theme. The theme toggle changes the visual appearance of the entire app without navigating.

views.title: Custom Theme Editor
views.description: v2: Admin-facing UI for configuring custom color palettes, fonts, and brand tokens. Preview mode shows changes in real-time.

views.title: User Theme Profiles
views.description: v2: Per-user theme settings page allowing customization beyond light/dark.
